name: BOS H&M X-Frame
summary: Automatic squaring and nailing station for timber-frame wall panels in a prefab plant. Servo-driven locating arms place the studs and CNC-controlled nail guns fix them, fed from the drawing software.

germany.statusNote: Sold by BOS Woodworking Solutions in Sneek, the Netherlands, through a contact-a-specialist form; no price is shown. No German dealer was checked.

sellers.name: BOS Woodworking Solutions
sellers.note: Koperslagersstraat 6, 8601 WL Sneek, Netherlands. Enquiry form only; options are priced per metre of extra capacity, stud carriage, laser and twin saws.

specs.label: Panel height
specs.quote: 1300mm minimum panel height Maximum panel height 5m

specs.label: Maximum panel length
specs.quote: Maximum panel length 6m – optionally up to 13m

specs.label: Control
specs.value: CNC control with 17-inch touchscreen; automatic download from drawing software (Sema, Dietrich's, HsbSoft, CADWORKS, Tekla Structures, Gang Nail, DDS, Mitek)

specs.label: Operators
specs.conditions: operator places components by hand in the centre of the panel; can override the automatic sequence
specs.quote: enable the machine to be used with a single operator

notes: A fixed plant station, not a mobile robot: heavy-duty tables with servo-positioned locating arms and nail guns.
The operator places studs and components by hand; the machine positions them, squares the panel and fires the nails per the CNC program.
Squaring and nailing only: no sawing or sheathing (the maker lists twin saws and a stud carriage as options).
